title: The Coding Conception of Set
summary: We propose the Coding Conception of ordinals and sets, which takes Cantor's three generating principles as its sole foundation. Bounded sets of ordinals are generated synchronously with the ordinals themselves through a bijective encoding function that, at each stage, selects only the finitely many bounded sets actually required by the successor, limit, and restriction principles.
